appendix: **Edit Mode turns.** In a Console Edit Mode turn, `.claude/skills/configure-console-product/scripts/edit-turn.mjs push` pushes the branch and finds or opens the draft pull request itself, with this run's token for that repository: do not call `open_pull_request` as well. The sandbox's own pre-push hook still runs after the turn's gate and still refuses the default branch.

**Package registry.** Every turn can install `@prism/*` from this environment's `prism` registry; npm and pnpm already have its scope and a read token, so never run `aws codeartifact login` or write a registry file. This prompt's line `- @prism (prism): the latest kit version published here is <kit_version>` names the kit version for [the Edit Mode kit bump](.claude/skills/configure-console-product/reference/edit-mode.md#bump-the-app-kit-when-the-registry-lacks-its-version).
